title: EC2 + EBS + Spot
topic: EBS gp3/io2/st1/sc1 volume selection, EBS vs EFS vs Instance Store, Spot vs On-Demand vs Fargate Spot, Iceland pipeline cost patterns, snapshots, hibernation, AWS Batch on Spot
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-27-ec2-ebs-spot.md and iceland-pipeline-compute.md. Answer without peeking at night-27-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: You launch a new Linux application server on EC2 and need a single-AZ boot volume with balanced price and performance. You want to tune IOPS independently of disk size. Which EBS volume type is the default exam answer?

options.A: sc1 — cold HDD for infrequent sequential reads at lowest $/GB
options.B: gp3 — general-purpose SSD with provisioned IOPS and throughput
options.C: st1 — throughput-optimized HDD for large sequential workloads
options.D: io2 Block Express — maximum IOPS for latency-sensitive databases

questions.question: A team runs Oracle on EC2 and needs 80,000+ sustained random IOPS with low latency. Cost is secondary. Which storage meets the requirement?

options.A: io2 or io2 Block Express provisioned IOPS SSD
options.B: gp3 with baseline 3,000 IOPS only — no further provisioning
options.C: st1 throughput HDD — IOPS scale with volume size per TiB
options.D: S3 Standard with byte-range GET as a block device substitute

questions.question: A log aggregation EC2 instance performs large sequential writes and reads. Lowest-cost HDD with high throughput matters more than IOPS. Which EBS type fits?

options.A: gp2 — legacy general SSD tied to volume size for IOPS
options.B: EFS One Zone-IA — NFS shared file system for many instances
options.C: st1 — throughput-optimized HDD for sequential workloads
options.D: Instance Store — ephemeral disks bundled with the instance

questions.question: Infrequently accessed bulk data on EC2 must use the lowest-cost magnetic-style HDD. Throughput requirements are minimal. Which volume type?

options.A: gp3 with minimum 125 MiB/s throughput provisioned
options.B: io2 Multi-Attach shared across three Availability Zones
options.C: EFS Standard — elastic NFS storage for shared access
options.D: sc1 — cold HDD optimized for infrequent access at low cost

questions.question: Global Ski Atlas runs the Iceland OSM pipeline monthly via EventBridge → Fargate. Jobs take about two hours and can be retried next month if interrupted. Which compute purchase model best reduces per-run cost?

options.A: Fargate Spot capacity provider or EC2 Spot for the batch worker
options.B: Dedicated Hosts — physical server isolation for the whole month
options.C: On-Demand EC2 reserved 24/7 with cron on the instance
options.D: Lambda with 15-minute maximum timeout for the entire ETL

questions.question: Production Aurora PostgreSQL holds resort_stats as the authoritative relational store. Which compute/storage pairing is inappropriate for the database layer?

options.A: Aurora Multi-AZ cluster with automated backups enabled
options.B: RDS on gp3 volumes with Multi-AZ failover
options.C: Spot EC2 with Instance Store as the only copy of database files
options.D: Aurora Serverless v2 with RDS Proxy in front of Lambda

questions.question: You must capture a consistent point-in-time copy of an EBS data volume for disaster recovery and later restore to a new volume in another Region. Which mechanism?

options.A: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the attached bucket
options.B: EBS snapshot stored in S3 — copy snapshot cross-Region if needed
options.C: Detach the live volume and attach it read-only to a second instance
options.D: Convert the gp3 volume to sc1 in place without downtime

questions.question: A video transcoding worker caches temporary frames on local disk. Data loss on instance stop is acceptable and you want the lowest latency local disk. What should you use?

options.A: gp3 root volume with maximum provisioned throughput
options.B: EFS Elastic throughput mode mounted on all workers
options.C: io2 volume with Multi-Attach in three subnets
options.D: Instance Store volumes included with the instance family

questions.question: Ten EC2 instances in one Region must read and write the same application configuration files concurrently without a custom sync layer. Which storage service?

options.A: Amazon EFS — shared NFS file system across instances
options.B: Single gp3 EBS volume attached to all ten instances by default
options.C: S3 objects mounted as a native POSIX block device on each host
options.D: ElastiCache Redis strings holding entire configuration files

questions.question: Your Spot Fleet runs stateless render workers. AWS may reclaim capacity with about two minutes of warning. Which allocation strategy tends to lower interruption rates at similar discount?

options.A: Lowest-price allocation across all instance pools regardless of capacity
options.B: Capacity-optimized allocation — pick pools with available Spot capacity
options.C: Dedicated Host affinity — bind jobs to a specific physical server
options.D: On-Demand base capacity only — no Spot instances in the fleet

questions.question: A gp3 data volume attached to a running EC2 instance needs higher provisioned IOPS for a nightly batch window. What is usually required?

options.A: Stop the instance, detach the volume, and create a snapshot first
options.B: Migrate the workload to Instance Store before changing IOPS
options.C: Use modify-volume to raise IOPS/throughput — typically no detach
options.D: Convert the volume to S3 Intelligent-Tiering for automatic scaling

questions.question: WORLD_SCALE PMTiles generation shards thousands of tile builds that write results to S3. Work is parallel and fault-tolerant. Which AWS service commonly orchestrates Spot compute for this pattern?

options.A: Amazon Cognito user pools — authenticate each tile worker
options.B: AWS DataSync — scheduled sync from on-premises tile storage
options.C: Amazon ElastiCache — cache finished PMTiles in Redis
options.D: AWS Batch with a Spot-based compute environment

questions.question: You want to enable EC2 hibernation so a dev instance resumes in-memory state after stop. Which root volume constraint applies?

options.A: Encrypted root volume up to 150 GiB on supported instance types
options.B: sc1 cold HDD root volume with Multi-AZ attachment
options.C: Unencrypted Instance Store root with T2 unlimited enabled
options.D: EFS root mount with Provisioned Throughput mode only

questions.question: An exam question asks which EBS volume types are generally suitable only as additional data volumes, not as root boot volumes on standard AMIs. Which pair?

options.A: gp3 and io2 — both block general-purpose and IOPS SSD
options.B: st1 and sc1 — throughput and cold HDD types
options.C: EFS and FSx — shared file systems instead of block
options.D: Instance Store and S3 — object and ephemeral stores

questions.question: After the Iceland Fargate task finishes, durable GeoParquet output must survive task stop and instance termination. Where should the pipeline write final artifacts?

options.A: Fargate ephemeral storage only — fastest and durable by default
options.B: EBS gp3 scratch volume without snapshot — primary system of record
options.C: S3 bucket prefix such as iceland/YYYY-MM/ — durable object store
options.D: ElastiCache Redis with AOF persistence for Parquet blobs
